source.rationale: humanLabel is shared code and the promotion domain is the only thing this node does not have, so the label chain must be pinned here on a domain it DOES have. A candidate whose canonical_code is uuid-shaped has no human code, so the label comes from `display` — and a candidate with no label at all is dropped before it can be probed. This node mirrors build-suggest-offer's selection EXACTLY; if the two disagree about which candidates survive, the annotation lands on codes that were never rendered. End of the chain: no display at all means no label, so the candidate is dropped rather than rendered as a raw uuid, and nothing is left to probe.
